name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 7 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 23 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 41 hours starting 2025-06-27, at wavelengths from 1.20 to 4.11 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
